fact_check.claim: F-1 and J-1 students limited to on-campus work for Cornell, paid by the university; F-1 can take any campus job, no special authorization
fact_check.note: Page says F-1 needs no special authorization and any on-campus job is allowed, even outside the field.

fact_check.claim: J-1 needs an on-campus employment letter before starting; authorization 12 months at a time; letter via iStart for a Cornell DS-2019; other sponsors such as Fulbright issue their own
fact_check.note: All stated on the page.

fact_check.claim: Up to 20 hours a week while classes in session and registered; exactly 20 is the maximum
fact_check.note: Quote: 'Exactly 20 hours is the maximum weekly time you can work.'

fact_check.claim: Breaks when not registered: full-time or part-time; end of semester full-time only after last class and last exam; other class-free periods full-time but must end before classes resume
fact_check.note: Matches the page.

fact_check.claim: Going over 20 hours, even once, is a serious status violation; contact International Services immediately
fact_check.note: Page calls it a serious status violation and says to contact an advisor immediately. Article now labels the all-jobs-combined reading as 'our reading', as the previous review asked.

fact_check.claim: Foreign national students not eligible for Federal Work Study; many campus jobs open anyway
fact_check.note: Stated on the page.

fact_check.claim: Authorization ends on completing final semester, leave of absence, or I-20/DS-2019 expiry
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Hiring department handles I-9, no need for International Services; J-1 students update it annually
fact_check.note: Page says complete with hiring department; International Services does not handle it; J-1 update annually. The 'because authorization runs 12 months' link is the article's inference and is reasonable.

fact_check.claim: Hourly student jobs are posted on the student job board in Workday; resume and cover letter are the first step; phishing warning and IT Phish Bowl
fact_check.note: All on the page. The earlier unsupported 'not placed in jobs, not guaranteed' sentence has been removed.

fact_check.claim: Student Employment contact: sesemp@cornell.edu and 607-255-5145
fact_check.note: Both listed.

fact_check.claim: After hire you get a Workday notification to complete Form I-9; Section 1 by first day of work but not before accepting the offer; original documents to an authorized Cornell representative within three business days of start; photocopies and digital images not accepted
fact_check.note: Matches. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Cornell HR has a guide for students completing the I-9 in Workday, a video on applying, and a job aid and video for entering time
fact_check.note: Page lists 'Apply to Hourly Student Jobs' video, 'Guidance for Students Completing the Form I9' PDF, and 'Student - Enter and Submit Time' job aid plus video.

fact_check.claim: International students should visit International Services before seeking on-campus employment; may not work during scheduled class times
fact_check.note: Both stated.

fact_check.claim: Student employees are paid bi-weekly on Thursdays, direct deposit or paper check
fact_check.note: Every two weeks on Thursdays; paper check if no direct deposit.

fact_check.claim: SSN: apply after at least 10 days in the U.S. and job started; 45 days to bring original documents to the Social Security office
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: F-1 campus job documents: passport, I-94, I-20, SSN eligibility letter, pay stub or hiring-department letter; J-1 needs eligibility letter
fact_check.note: Page lists these for campus job holders (I-20 for F-1, DS-2019 for J-1).

fact_check.claim: Eligibility letter valid 30 days; request when applying within about two weeks
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Ithaca Social Security office: 127 West State Street, second floor of the Greenstate Building
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Page does not say whether you can work before the SSN arrives; existing SSN means no new one needed
fact_check.note: Page does not state it directly; says SSN is yours for life.

fact_check.claim: Even with no U.S. income, send IRS Form 8843; generally no return then; Sprintax free
fact_check.note: Page says no return needed but must still send Form 8843. Previous fix applied.

fact_check.claim: Federal and New York returns for the 2026 tax year are due April 15, 2027; wages are U.S.-source income
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Many nonresidents exempt from Social Security and Medicare taxes in first five years; refund via employer or when filing
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Foreign National Questionnaire is how Cornell applies tax treaty benefits to campus pay
fact_check.note: Matches.

fact_check.claim: Cornell Tech encourages Masters students to limit work to 10 hours a week; advises against TurboTax
fact_check.note: Both stated; the article labels the 10 hours as a Cornell Tech recommendation, not a visa rule.

fact_check.claim: CPT requires a U.S.-based employer, a job related to the major, application through myStatus, and a new I-20 before working
fact_check.note: All stated. The page also describes a graduation-requirement test that the article does not mention; this is an omission, not an error.

fact_check.claim: Academic calendar link for semester dates
fact_check.note: Navigation link only, not fetched. No hard fact depends on it.

beats_top.query: cornell international student jobs on campus F-1 how to find
beats_top.why: The #1 result is Cornell's official rules page. It gives the hours and status rules but not the practical path of Workday search, I-9 timing, SSN order, pay and taxes. Our page answers in the first paragraph and then walks through those steps, with every figure linked to official pages.
